instruction: Draw an arc slot in the first quadrant. Its centerline is a 90 degree arc centered at the origin with radius 20, starting on the positive X axis and ending on the positive Y axis. The slot width is 6, so the outer boundary arc has radius 23 and the inner boundary arc has radius 17, both centered at the origin and spanning from 0 degrees to 90 degrees. Close the start and end of the slot with radius 3 semicircular end caps centered at (20, 0) and (0, 20). Do not leave any construction or helper geometry in the final sketch. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
